fix(design-release-2-1-commodities-and-reason): Remove on Commodity details keeps the numbers the trader has typed but not yet saved
fix(design-release-2-1-commodities-and-reason): The frontend's stub commodity fixture matches what the MDM stub serves
feat(design-release-2-1-commodities-and-reason): Species read as their scientific name with the common name in brackets
feat(design-release-2-1-commodities-and-reason): The number of packages question is pinned to the V4 Data Fields commodity list
feat(design-release-2-1-commodities-and-reason): Unweaned question is asked for equines, cattle, pigs, sheep and goats
feat(design-release-2-1-commodities-and-reason): Save and return to overview makes the same checks as Save and continue on the main import reason and additional details pages
feat(design-release-2-1-commodities-and-reason): End-to-end proof: poultry by rail in transit, as far as the review
feat(design-release-2-1-commodities-and-reason): Hard stops: means of transport on arrival details and number of packages on commodity details
feat(design-release-2-1-commodities-and-reason): The theme branch takes in what main has landed since it was cut
feat(design-release-2-1-commodities-and-reason): Commodity search results sorted and bolded, and a selected panel of removable species chips

scenarios.heading: A removal submitted again shows the page as it stands rather than removing another row

steps.text: the user has removed a row
the same removal is submitted again
the commodity details page is shown holding the rows the first removal left, with nothing further removed

scenarios.heading: A number of animals above the largest the service stores is refused on its own field

steps.text: the user is entering a number of animals for one species
they enter a number above 2,147,483,647 and save
the save is blocked, with the error "Number of animals must be 2,147,483,647 or fewer" against that species' own field
the field still shows the digits they typed

scenarios.heading: A number of animals at the largest the service stores is accepted

steps.text: the user is entering a number of animals for one species
they enter 2,147,483,647 and save
the save is not blocked and the journey moves on
reopening the page shows the figure that was saved

scenarios.heading: A number of packages above the largest the service stores is refused on its own field

steps.text: the user is entering a number of packages for one species
they enter a number above 2,147,483,647 and save
the save is blocked, with the error "Number of packages must be 2,147,483,647 or fewer" against that species' own field
the field still shows the digits they typed

scenarios.heading: A number of packages at the largest the service stores is accepted

steps.text: the user is entering a number of packages for one species
they enter 2,147,483,647 and save
the save is not blocked and the journey moves on

scenarios.heading: A number of animals above the largest signed 64-bit integer is refused on its own field
A number of animals at the largest signed 64-bit integer is accepted
Pressing Enter in a quantity field saves the counts

steps.text: the user has entered valid counts for every species
they press Enter in a quantity field
the counts are saved and the page the primary save leads to is shown

scenarios.heading: Numbers typed into other rows survive a removal

steps.text: the user has typed numbers into more than one species' fields and has not yet saved
they remove one row
that row is gone from the table and from the selection
every other species' field still holds the number typed into it

scenarios.heading: A removal submitted again is refused rather than removing another row
Each row's Species cell lists the labels chosen under it

steps.text: the user has chosen two species under commodity code 0102
they view the commodity details page
the table has the columns "Commodity code" and "Species"
the 0102 row reads 0102 and the label of each of the two species

scenarios.heading: Searching by common name offers each matching species under each live-animal code that lists it, by its Latin name with its common name in brackets

steps.text: the user is on the commodity selection page
they search by a species' common name
each matching species is offered under each live-animal commodity code that lists it, by its Latin name with its common name in round brackets

scenarios.heading: Searching by commodity code offers the species that search returns under that code, by its Latin name with its common name in brackets

steps.text: the user is on the commodity selection page
they search for a live-animal commodity code whose search lists no more than a hundred species
those species are offered under that code, each by its Latin name with its common name in round brackets

scenarios.heading: Searching by a species' Latin name, or one word of it, offers that species under each live-animal code that lists it, by its Latin name with its common name in brackets

steps.text: the user is on the commodity selection page
they search by a species' Latin name, or one word of it
that species is offered under each live-animal code that lists it, by its Latin name with its common name in round brackets

scenarios.heading: A species the reference data holds no common name for is offered by its Latin name alone

steps.text: the reference data holds no common name for a species a search matches
the results are shown
that species is offered by its Latin name alone, with no brackets

scenarios.heading: Two species of one commodity share a row listing both labels and their total

steps.text: the user has chosen two species under one commodity (for example, two cattle species with 2 and 3 animals)
they open the identification details page
the summary shows one row for that commodity code, listing both labels
its number of animals is the total of the two species

scenarios.heading: A line whose commodity is not counted in packages is asked for a number of animals only

steps.text: the user has added a commodity line
its commodity is one the reference data serves but is not counted in packages
that line is asked for a number of animals only, both on the commodity details page and on the review

scenarios.heading: A cats-dogs-and-ferrets-only consignment is not asked about unweaned animals

steps.text: a notification whose only commodity line carries the cats, dogs, ferrets and other live mammals commodity (01061900)
the user works through the journey
the notification is not asked whether it contains unweaned animals

scenarios.heading: Adding an equine, pig, sheep or goat commodity also brings the question into play

steps.text: a notification whose commodity lines carry no commodity requiring unweaned-animal tracking
the user adds a line carrying an equine, a pig, a sheep or a goat commodity
the notification is asked whether it contains unweaned animals, as a mandatory answer

scenarios.heading: A consignment with an unweaned-eligible commodity is asked about unweaned animals

steps.text: the user has reached the additional details page for a consignment at least one of whose commodity lines is among those the service treats as capable of being unweaned
the page loads
it asks the unweaned question alongside the certification question, with the unweaned question's hint and both of its options
an answer given to the unweaned question is saved and still shown as chosen when the page is reopened

scenarios.heading: Save and return refuses a partly answered reveal while amending

steps.text: the main import reason page of a notification being amended, with "Transit" chosen and its port of exit and destination country left blank
the user selects "Save and return"
they stay on the page, which shows an error for each missing answer
nothing is saved

scenarios.heading: Save and return to overview inside the sequence goes to Overview rather than the next step

steps.text: the user is in the opening sequence on main import reason, with the reason and the question it opens answered
they select "Save and return to overview"
Overview is shown, not commodity details

scenarios.heading: Save and return to overview from additional details inside the sequence goes to Overview rather than the next step

steps.text: the user is in the opening sequence on additional details, with the certification question answered
they select "Save and return to overview"
Overview is shown, not the port of entry

scenarios.heading: Save and return to overview refuses the same invalid certification purpose, keeping a valid unweaned answer

steps.text: the user has validly answered the unweaned question
they submit an invalid certification purpose and choose save and return to overview
the save is refused, an error links to and focuses the certification question, with nothing shown as chosen there
the unweaned question still shows the answer already given

scenarios.heading: Save and return to overview refuses the same invalid unweaned answer, keeping a valid certification purpose

steps.text: the user has validly answered the certification question
they submit an invalid unweaned answer and choose save and return to overview
the save is refused with "Select a valid option" for the unweaned question and nothing is saved
the certification question still shows the purpose already chosen

scenarios.heading: Save and return to overview accepts the page with both questions left blank

steps.text: the user is on the additional details page with neither question answered
they choose save and return to overview
the blank answers are saved
reopening the page shows neither question answered

scenarios.heading: The Additional details task walks To do, In progress and Complete on its own answers alone

steps.text: a consignment whose commodities put the unweaned question in scope, with no import reason saved
the user views Overview before either question is answered
Additional details reads To do
only what the animals are certified for is answered and the user views Overview
Additional details reads In progress
the unweaned question is also answered and the user views Overview
Additional details reads Complete

scenarios.heading: Choosing a commodity that needs no identifiers leaves the row out

steps.text: the user has chosen a commodity that carries no identifiers
they view Overview
no Identification details row is shown
the second section lists Commodity details, then Additional details, in that order

scenarios.heading: Arrival details saved and returned without a means of transport is refused

steps.text: the Arrival details page with a port of entry chosen and no means of transport
the user selects "Save and return to overview"
they stay on the page, which shows "Select a means of transport to the port of entry"
the port of entry they chose is still shown
nothing is saved, so re-opening the task from Overview shows no port

scenarios.heading: Saving with no means of transport chosen is refused

steps.text: the user is on the arrival details page with no means of transport chosen
they save and continue
an error summary headed "There is a problem" is shown, carrying "Select a means of transport to the port of entry" linked to the means of transport question
they remain on the arrival details page, with nothing saved

scenarios.heading: Save and return to overview refuses the save the same way

steps.text: the user has chosen a port of entry and no means of transport
they select "Save and return to overview"
they remain on the arrival details page with the same error, the port they chose still shown
reopening the task from Overview shows no saved port

scenarios.heading: The tally reports the choice as a bold commodity line and its species, and clearing empties it

steps.text: the user has chosen one species on the commodity selection page
the page next renders
the tally reports one chosen, showing the commodity as a bold line with the species beneath it
each entry offers a control whose accessible name is "Remove" followed by that species' label
the user clears the selection
the tally is no longer shown

scenarios.heading: Removing one chosen species leaves the other chosen

steps.text: the user has chosen two species under different commodities
they use the remove control named for one of them
that species is gone from the tally, the other is still chosen, and the results on screen are still listed

scenarios.heading: With JavaScript off, searching, removing a species and clearing all still work

steps.text: the user has JavaScript turned off
they search, remove one chosen species, and clear the selection
each of the three works

scenarios.heading: Unticking a shown species and then removing it leaves it unchosen without an error

steps.text: a species whose tick box is on screen and ticked
the user clears that tick box and then uses that species' remove control
the page is shown with that species not chosen and the other choices still chosen, not an error page

scenarios.heading: A removal naming a species the page never offered is refused and changes nothing

steps.text: a removal naming a species the page's results and the saved commodity lines have never held, however it was submitted
the page responds
the request is refused, no page is rendered back, and the selection is unchanged

scenarios.heading: A search lists its groups and species alphabetically

steps.text: a search whose commodity lists its species in another order
the results are shown
the species are listed in label order under their commodity heading, and the commodity groups are in heading order

scenarios.heading: A search bolds the part of a species label it matched

steps.text: a search for part of a species' label
the results are shown
that part of the label is in bold and the rest is not

scenarios.heading: A search bolds the part of a commodity heading it matched

steps.text: a search for part of a commodity heading
the results are shown
that part of the heading is in bold and the rest is not
